freeze.author: AI agent; newly withheld documents, not independently curated human holdout
freeze.selection: Two official Samsung 2025 reports not in the existing 2024 development corpus. Four metrics, two statement scopes, current and prior year, quarter and YTD. Same issuer and similar layouts.
freeze.gold_method: AI transcribed official PDF cells before running evaluation. Expected arithmetic independently computed with Fraction; source-literal net-profit anomaly retained. No production predictions used for labels.

known_source_anomaly.observation: pypdf text, independent PyMuPDF text and AI inspection of rasterized page agree. Not human reviewed. Do not silently replace printed values.

evaluation_type: Post-disclosure remediation regression; NOT unseen heldout
cost_scope: Paid model APIs only; excludes CPU, storage and network
adapter: Fixtures supplied directly to SearchIndex/core; isolated source_manifest and source_facts patches; real current valid_source

end_to_end.claim: No successful raw-PDF-to-answer evaluation. Downstream fixture results are diagnostic only.
